description: Meta-agent that systematically transforms hardcoded systems into universal, industry-agnostic systems with NO limitations

tasks.title: Setup Node.js Project with AST Parsing
tasks.description: Initialize the Node.js project structure with necessary dependencies for AST parsing and code analysis capabilities.
tasks.details: Create Node.js project with TypeScript support. Install @babel/parser, @babel/traverse, @babel/types, handlebars, typescript. Setup project structure with /src/analyzers, /transformers, /templates, /validators, /utils directories.

tasks.title: Implement Code Analysis System
tasks.description: Build a system that analyzes existing code to identify hardcoded elements, including industry lists, location restrictions, and business type limitations.
tasks.details: Create AST-based code analyzer that can parse JavaScript and TypeScript files. Implement pattern detection for hardcoded arrays, numeric limitations, conditional logic, API endpoints, and UI text.

tasks.title: Develop Transformation System
tasks.description: Create a system that transforms hardcoded elements into dynamic, configuration-driven code following the All-Purpose Pattern methodology.
tasks.details: Implement AST transformation utilities to replace hardcoded elements with dynamic configuration references. Transform arrays, limits, conditions, and messaging to use userInput configuration.

tasks.title: Build Template Generation System
tasks.description: Develop a Handlebars-based template generation system that creates universal templates for any context without hardcoded limitations.
tasks.details: Create template engine integration for generating dynamic prompt templates, API handlers, UI components, and configuration schemas using Handlebars.

tasks.title: Implement Validation System
tasks.description: Create a comprehensive validation system that ensures no hardcoded limitations remain in generated code and verifies unlimited scalability.
tasks.details: Implement validation checks for hardcoded industries, location limitations, business type restrictions, numeric limits, and configuration-driven behavior.
